### Preparation: Creating conda environments with necessary packages

You will need the following conda packages for this script, which are available in the Bioconda channel:

- minimap2
- samtools
- dbcan
- Diamond
- barrnap
- pyani-plus
- seaborn
- mummer
- hmmer

As well as the following Python packages: biopython, pandas and biolib.

```{bash, eval = FALSE}
# Preparation: create conda environment with necessary packages
# Language: BASH (copy and paste to run in terminal)
# Note: only run this if you do not have the packages in your current instance/conda environment

conda init bash
source ~/.bashrc
conda create -n mag_mapper -c bioconda -c conda-forge minimap2 samtools diamond dbcan barrnap pyani-plus seaborn mummer hmmer
conda activate mag_mapper

# If you do not have the Python packages biopython and pandas installed, please run:
pip install biopython
pip install pandas
pip install biolib
```

# Mapping metatranscriptome onto annotated genomes

### Create bowtie2 dictionaries from the MAG fasta file

```{bash, eval = FALSE}
# create bowtie2 dictionaries from MAG fasta files
# Language: BASH
# Requirements: bowtie2
# Input: MAG fasta files (.fasta)
# Output: bowtie2 dictionaries (.bt2)

bowtie2-build -f ../contig_fasta/11_contig_2.fasta, ../contig_fasta/13_21_contig_1.fasta bowtie_aoa 

```

### Map metatranscriptomes onto MAG dictionaries

```{bash, eval = FALSE}
# Map metatranscriptome sto MAG dictionaries
# Language: Bash
# Requirements: bowtie2
# Input: MAG fasta file (.fasta), metatranscriptome fasta file (.fasta)
# Output: MAG to metatranscriptome mapping file (.sam)

for file in metatranscriptomes/*.fasta; do
  # get the base name of the file
  read_base=$(basename $file .fasta)
  # run the mapping script
  bowtie2 -f --sensitive -p 8 -x bowtie_aoa -U $file -S $read_base.sam;
done

```

### Transform mapping file to sorted, indexed bam file

```{bash, eval = FALSE}
# Transform mapping file to sorted, indexed bam file
# Language: BASH
# Requirements: samtools
# Input: MAG to metatranscriptome mapping file (.sam)
# Output: sorted and indexed bam file of mapping file (.sorted.bam)

for f in *.sam
do
  base=$(basename $f .sam)
  samtools view -Sb $base.sam > $base.bam
done

for f in *.bam
do
  base=$(basename $f .bam)
  samtools sort $base.bam -o $base.sorted.bam
  samtools index $base.sorted.bam
done

```

### Extract mapped reads from sorted .bam files using FeatureCounts in R

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Extract mapped reads from sorted .bam files using FeatureCounts in R
# Language: R
# Requirements: tidyverse, dplyr, Rsubread, stringr
# Input: sorted and indexed bam file (.sorted.bam), .gff files for genomes
# Output: coverage statistics, details and total coverage of mapping for each MAG (.csv)

setwd('~/aoa_mags/mag_mt_mapping/bowtie2_output')

sorted_files <- list.files(pattern = 'sorted.bam$')

calculate_coverage <- function(file_key, annotation_path, ec_name){
  
  stats <- data.frame()
  coverage <- data.frame()
  
  for(i in sorted_files){

        fc <- featureCounts(files = i, 
                          annot.ext = annotation_path,
                          isGTFAnnotationFile = TRUE,
                          GTF.featureType = 'CDS',
                          GTF.attrType = 'locus_tag')
 
  
        if(nrow(stats) == 0){
          stats <- fc$stat
        } else { stats <- left_join(stats, fc$stat, by = 'Status')}
  
        if(nrow(coverage) == 0){
          coverage <- fc$counts
        } else {
          coverage <- merge(coverage, fc$counts, by = 0)
          coverage <- coverage %>% column_to_rownames(var = 'Row.names')
        }
    }
  
  
  stats <- stats %>% column_to_rownames(var = 'Status')
  stats <- stats %>% rbind(Total_Reads = colSums(stats))
  stats <- as.data.frame(t(stats))
  stats <- stats %>% mutate(Perc_Assigned = Assigned / Total_Reads)
  
  write.csv(stats, paste0("~/aoa_mags/featurecounts_mage/", ec_name, "_coverage_stats.csv"), row.names=TRUE)
  write.csv(coverage, paste0("~/aoa_mags/featurecounts_mage/", ec_name, "_coverage_details.csv"), row.names=TRUE)
  
  coverage <- coverage[rowSums(coverage)>0,]

  coverage <- coverage %>% mutate(Volume = rowSums(coverage)) %>% arrange(desc(Volume))

  write.csv(coverage, paste0("~/aoa_mags/featurecounts_mage/", ec_name, "_coverage.csv"), row.names=TRUE)
  
}

calculate_coverage(file_key="11_contig_2", 
                   annotation_path='~/aoa_mags/mag_annotation_mage/Candidatus_Nitrosocosmicus_sp._EC11.gff',
                   ec_name="ec11")

calculate_coverage(file_key="13_21_contig_1",
                   annotation_path="~/aoa_mags/mag_annotation_mage/Nitrosotalea_sp._EC131.gff",
                   ec_name="ec131")
```

# Calculate TPM for expressed genes

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# Calculate TPM for expressed genes
# Language: R
# Requirements: tidyverse, dplyr
# Input: mag_coverage files for each enrichment culture
# Output: file with TPM of expressed genes (.csv)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)

setwd('~/aoa_mags/mag_coverage_analysis')

ec131 <- read.csv('ec131_mage_coverage.csv')
ec11 <- read.csv('ec11_mage_coverage.csv')

coverage <- rbind(ec11, ec131)

# tpm

time_points <- c('Apr_PD1', 'Apr_PD2', 'Apr_PD3', 'Aug_PD1', 'Aug_PD2', 'Aug_PD3', 'Oct_PD1', 'Oct_PD2', 'Oct_PD3')
cultures <- c('Ca. Nitrosocosmicus', 'Nitrosotalea 131')

data.long <- pivot_longer(coverage, cols = -c('locus_tag', 'length', 'product', 'Total', 'Culture'), names_to = 'Sample', values_to = 'Reads')

data.long <- data.long %>% mutate(length_kb = length/1000,
                                  reads_per_kb_length = Reads/length_kb)

data.long$per_million_factor <- NA

for(i in cultures){
  for(j in time_points){
    subset <- data.long[data.long$Culture == i & data.long$Sample == j,]
    total_reads_per_kb <- sum(subset$reads_per_kb_length)
    reads_per_kb_million <- total_reads_per_kb / 1000000
    data.long[data.long$Culture == i & data.long$Sample == j,]$per_million_factor <- reads_per_kb_million
  }
}

data.long <- data.long %>% mutate(TPM = reads_per_kb_length/per_million_factor)

write.csv(data.long, "transcript_hits_tpm.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```

# CAZYme analysis

### Download and prepare dbcan3 for CAZyme mapping

```{bash, eval = FALSE}
# Download and prepare dbcan3 for CAZyme mapping
# Language: BASH
# Requirements: dbcan, diamond, blast, pybiolib (Python package)
# Input: files from dbCAN3
# Output: database folder (db) with necessary databases

conda activate dbcan
test -d db || mkdir db
cd db \
    && wget http://bcb.unl.edu/dbCAN2/download/Databases/fam-substrate-mapping-08012023.tsv && mv fam-substrate-mapping-08012023.tsv fam-substrate-mapping.tsv \
    && wget http://bcb.unl.edu/dbCAN2/download/Databases/PUL.faa \
    && wget http://bcb.unl.edu/dbCAN2/download/Databases/dbCAN-PUL_12-12-2023.xlsx && mv dbCAN-PUL_12-12-2023.xlsx dbCAN-PUL.xlsx \
    && wget http://bcb.unl.edu/dbCAN2/download/Databases/dbCAN-PUL.tar.gz && tar xvf dbCAN-PUL.tar.gz && rm dbCAN-PUL.tar.gz \
    && wget https://bcb.unl.edu/dbCAN2/download/Databases/dbCAN_sub.hmm \
    && wget https://bcb.unl.edu/dbCAN2/download/Databases/V12/CAZyDB.07262023.fa && mv CAZyDB.07262023.fa CAZyDB.fa \
    && wget https://bcb.unl.edu/dbCAN2/download/Databases/V12/dbCAN-HMMdb-V12.txt && mv dbCAN-HMMdb-V12.txt dbCAN.txt \
    && wget https://bcb.unl.edu/dbCAN2/download/Databases/V12/tcdb.fa  \
    && wget http://bcb.unl.edu/dbCAN2/download/Databases/V12/tf-1.hmm \
    && wget http://bcb.unl.edu/dbCAN2/download/Databases/V12/tf-2.hmm \
    && wget https://bcb.unl.edu/dbCAN2/download/Databases/V12/stp.hmm

conda activate blast
makeblastdb -in PUL.faa -dbtype prot

conda activate diamond
diamond makedb --in CAZyDB.fa -d CAZy
diamond makedb --in tcdb.fa -d tcdb

pip install pybiolib
biolib run HMMER/hmmpress dbCAN_sub.hmm
biolib run HMMER/hmmpress dbCAN.txt
biolib run HMMER/hmmpress tf-1.hmm
biolib run HMMER/hmmpress tf-2.hmm
biolib run HMMER/hmmpress stp.hmm
    
```

### Run dbcan3 to identify CAZymes in MAGs

```{bash, eval = FALSE}
# Run dbcan to identify CAZymes
# Language: BASH
# Requirements: dbcan with full suite of databases
# Input: MAG fasta file (.fasta), MAG label file (.gff)
# Output: dbcan output folder with HMM results

conda activate run_dbcan_env
run_dbcan database --db_dir db # create database - takes a long time, so if you've already done this skip this step!!!!
run_dbcan CAZyme_annotation --input_raw_data NC11_contig_2.fasta --mode prok --output_dir NC11_cazyme --db_dir db
run_dbcan CAZyme_annotation --input_raw_data 13_21_contig_1.fasta --mode prok --output_dir NT131_cazyme --db_dir db
```

### Extract CAZyme hits from dbcan output

```{bash, eval = FALSE}
pip install biopython
```

```{python, eval = FALSE}
# Extract CAZyme hits from dbcan output
# Language: Python
# Requirements: Python packages (SeqIO, pandas)
# Input: HMM output file (hmmer.out), dbcan formatted input file (uniInput)
# Output: fasta file of CAZymes present in the MAGs (.fasta)
from Bio import SeqIO
import pandas as pd
import os

os.chdir('/home/rstudio/aoa_mags/mag_mt_mapping/CAZymes/NC11_cazyme') # run this for each CAZyme output (change path)

hits_path = 'dbCAN_hmm_results.tsv'
seqs_path = 'uniInput.faa'
output_file = 'NC11_cazyme_positive_hits.fasta'

hits = pd.read_csv(hits_path, sep='\t')
true_hits = hits[(hits['i-Evalue'] < 1e-15) & (hits['Coverage'] > 0.8)]
cazyme_ids = true_hits['Target Name'].tolist()

for record in SeqIO.parse(seqs_path, 'fasta'):
   if record.id in cazyme_ids:
       with open(output_file, 'a') as f:
           f.write(f'>{record.id}\n')
           f.write(f'{record.seq}\n')
```

### Combine CAZyme hits with mapping results to analyze CAZyme expression

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# Combine CAZyme hits with mapping results to analyze CAZyme expression
# Language: R
# Requirements: dplyr, stringr, tidyverse, readxl
# Input: TPM for mapping results, dbCAN hmm results for each culture
# Output: cazyme tpm coverage file (.csv)

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)

setwd('~/aoa_mags/mag_mt_mapping/CAZymes')

tpm <- read_csv('~/aoa_mags/mag_coverage_analysis/transcript_hits_tpm.csv') %>% filter(Culture %in% c('Ca. Nitrosocosmicus', 'Nitrosotalea 131'))

## Nitrosocosmicus (NC11)

nc11_hmm <- read_delim("NC11_cazyme/dbCAN_hmm_results.tsv", 
                       delim = "\t", escape_double = FALSE, 
                       trim_ws = TRUE)

nc11_hmm <- nc11_hmm %>% filter(`i-Evalue` < 1e-15,
                          Coverage > 0.8)

nc11_locus_tags <- read_xlsx('NC11_cazyme/NC11_Cazyme_IDs.xlsx')
nc11_hmm_locus_tags <- left_join(nc11_hmm, nc11_locus_tags, by = 'Target Name')

nc11_tpm <- left_join(nc11_hmm_locus_tags, tpm, by = 'locus_tag', relationship = 'many-to-many')


## Nitrosotalea (NT131)

nt131_hmm <- read_delim("NT131_cazyme/dbCAN_hmm_results.tsv", 
                       delim = "\t", escape_double = FALSE, 
                       trim_ws = TRUE)

nt131_hmm <- nt131_hmm %>% filter(`i-Evalue` < 1e-15,
                                Coverage > 0.8)

nt131_locus_tags <- read_xlsx('NT131_cazyme/NT131_Cazyme_IDs.xlsx')
nt131_hmm_locus_tags <- left_join(nt131_hmm, nt131_locus_tags, by = 'Target Name')

nt131_tpm <- left_join(nt131_hmm_locus_tags, tpm, by = 'locus_tag', relationship = 'many-to-many')

# Join data
 
cazyme_tpm <- rbind(nc11_tpm, nt131_tpm)
 
write.csv(cazyme_tpm, '~/aoa_mags/mag_coverage_analysis/cazyme_tpm_coverage.csv', row.names = FALSE)

```

# Average nucleotide identity (ANI) to other genomes available in MAGE/Microscope

```{bash, eval = FALSE}
# Use Barrnap to confirm conserved rRNA regions
# Language: bash
# Requirements: mag_mapper conda environment with pyani-plus, seaborn and mummer
# Input: downloaded sequences from MAGE for each genome that are extracted into folders, "cosmicus_ani/" and "talea_ani/", respectively
# Output: many files comparing all the sequences included in the folders

# Nitrosocosmicus

pyani-plus anim cosmicus_ani/ --database cosmicus.db --create-db --name cosmicus 

pyani-plus export-run --database cosmicus.db --outdir cosmicus_ani/

pyani-plus plot-run --database cosmicus.db --outdir cosmicus_ani/

# Nitrosotalea

pyani-plus anim talea_ani/ --database talea.db --create-db --name talea 

pyani-plus export-run --database talea.db --outdir cosmicus_ani/

pyani-plus plot-run --database cosmicus.db --outdir cosmicus_ani/
```

# Identify copper centers with PFAM HMM in Hmmer

### Run PFAM HMM for both genomes

```{bash, eval = FALSE}
# Identify copper centers with PFAM HMM in Hmmer
# Language: bash
# Requirements: mag_mapper conda environment with hmmer installed
# Input: Pfam databases (installed in script), protein files downloaded from MAGE (.1-Proteins.fasta)
# Output: HMM output per domain (.domtblout)

## adapted from https://github.com/aziele/pfam_scan

wget http://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/Pfam/current_release/Pfam-A.hmm.dat.gz
wget http://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/Pfam/current_release/Pfam-A.hmm.gz

mkdir pfamdb
gunzip -c Pfam-A.hmm.dat.gz > pfamdb/Pfam-A.hmm.dat
gunzip -c Pfam-A.hmm.gz > pfamdb/Pfam-A.hmm
rm Pfam-A.hmm.gz Pfam-A.hmm.dat.gz

hmmpress pfamdb/Pfam-A.hmm

hmmscan --domtblout nt131.domtblout -E 1e-5 pfamdb/Pfam-A.hmm EC131NT.1-Proteins.fasta 
hmmscan --domtblout nc11.domtblout -E 1e-5 pfamdb/Pfam-A.hmm EC11NC.1-Proteins.fasta 
```

### Reformat HMM results

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# Reformat HMM results
# Language: R
# Requirements: dplyr, stringr
# Input: .domtblout files for both genomes
# Output: cleaned files with PFAM HMM results (.csv)

## Nitrosocosmicus genome

nc11 <- read_table("~/aoa_mags/hmmer_pfam/nc11.domtblout", 
                   col_names = FALSE, comment = "#")
nc11 <- as.data.frame(nc11)
colnames(nc11) <- c('target_name', 'target_accession', 'target_length', 'query_name', 'query_accession', 'query_length',
                    'E-value', 'score', 'bias', 'num_domain', 'total_domains', 'conditional-Evalue',
                    'independent-Evalue', 'domain_score', 'domain_bias', 'hmm_from', 'hmm_to',
                    'alignment_from', 'alignment_to', 'seq_from', 'seq_too', 'accuracy', 'description1', 'description2', 'description3')
nc11$description <- str_c(nc11$description1, nc11$description2, nc11$description3, sep = ' ')
nc11 <- nc11 %>% select(-description1, -description2, -description3)

write.csv(nc11, 'hmmer_pfam/nc11_pfam_results.csv', row.names = FALSE)

## Nitrosotalea genome

nt131 <- read_table("~/aoa_mags/hmmer_pfam/nt131.domtblout", 
                   col_names = FALSE, comment = "#")
nt131 <- as.data.frame(nt131)
colnames(nt131) <- c('target_name', 'target_accession', 'target_length', 'query_name', 'query_accession', 'query_length',
                    'E-value', 'score', 'bias', 'num_domain', 'total_domains', 'conditional-Evalue',
                    'independent-Evalue', 'domain_score', 'domain_bias', 'hmm_from', 'hmm_to',
                    'alignment_from', 'alignment_to', 'seq_from', 'seq_too', 'accuracy', 'description1', 'description2')
nt131$description <- str_c(nt131$description1, nt131$description2, sep = ' ')
nt131 <- nt131 %>% select(-description1, -description2)

write.csv(nt131, 'hmmer_pfam/nt131_pfam_results.csv', row.names = FALSE)

```

### Extract protein hits with copper center

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# Extract protein hits with copper center
# Language: R
# Requirements: dplyr
# Input: cleaned PFAM output files for each genome (.csv)
# Output: cleaned files with copper center proteins out of PFAM HMM results (.csv)

## Nitrosotalea

nt_131 <- read.csv("hmmer_pfam/nt131_pfam_results.csv")

query_names <- c("Cupredoxin_1", "COX1", "COX2", "Copper-bind", "Cu-oxidase", "Cu-oxidase_2", "Cu-oxidase_3")

product_names_nt131 <- nt131$query_name %>% unique() 

nt.copper <- data.frame()

for(i in product_names_nt131){
  temp <- nt131 %>% filter(query_name == i)
  for(j in 1:nrow(temp)){
    if(temp[j,]$target_name %in% query_names){
      nt.copper <- rbind(nt.copper, temp)
      break 
    }
    break
  }
}

write.csv(nt.copper, 'hmmer_pfam/nt131_copper_pfam.csv', row.names=FALSE)

## Nitrosocosmicus

nc_11 <- read.csv("hmmer_pfam/nc11_pfam_results.csv")

product_names_nc11 <- nc11$query_name %>% unique() 

nc.copper <- data.frame()

for(i in product_names_nc11){
  temp <- nc11 %>% filter(query_name == i)
  for(j in 1:nrow(temp)){
    if(temp[j,]$target_name %in% query_names){
      nc.copper <- rbind(nc.copper, temp)
      break 
    }
    break
  }
}

write.csv(nc.copper, 'hmmer_pfam/nc11_copper_pfam.csv', row.names=FALSE)

```
